summary: Naresh Jain compares coding agents building the same API service with and without a behavioral harness. A frontier model, GPT-6 Sol, passed every external evaluation either way.
takeaways: A frontier model, GPT-6 Sol, passed every external evaluation either way.
But a cost-optimized model, GPT-6 Luna, succeeded in only 3 of 10 unharnessed runs and all 10 with the harness.
This experiment suggests a behavioral harness might be a practical way to get dependable results from smaller, cost-optimized models. more…
